posts.body:
Hey guys, I just started developing RPG Maker MZ games a couple weeks ago, and am working on a Life Simulator game similar to those games you see on SugarCube HTML games. As part of the game, any plugins that I make; I will most likely post them here. More information on the game on the bottom of the forum. I plan to integrate this with my own quest plugin, however I am working on a integration with various quest systems as we speak.
Keep in mind, even though this is a
very simple
plugin i've chose to add a optional version which allows modification and commercial use for
only
1 USD, this is to allow me to fund my game with asset makers as I am only a programmer.
If you have any suggestions for plugins that I should make please let me know; I am looking for experience in RPG Maker MZ
PLUGIN LINK HERE
Quest Log System | RPG Maker MZ by gmoddev
Enhance your RPG with a customizable quest tracking system for a seamless player experience.
gmoddev.itch.io
PLUGIN DESCRIPTION (From Itch.io):
The Quest Log Plugin is a simple, efficient solution for RPG Maker MZ, allowing developers to easily add a customizable quest log for players to track their objectives. With features that let you add, update, and display quest details in-game, this plugin is designed to provide a smooth and organized experience for both players and developers.
Key Features:​
Direct Integration with VisuStella Main Menu:
Complete integration with VisuStella’s Main Menu Plugin.
Customizable Quests:
Add quests with detailed descriptions, objectives, quest givers, and locations.
Dynamic Updates:
Update quests’ statuses dynamically, keeping players informed of their progress.
Quest Categories:
Automatically organizes ongoing and completed quests for clarity and ease of access.
User-Friendly Interface:
Built to integrate seamlessly into your RPG Maker MZ project, with an intuitive layout for players to view quest information.
Free Version:
The free version of the Quest Log Plugin is fully functional, letting you implement a quest log in any RPG Maker MZ project for non-commercial purposes. This version is ideal for personal projects or hobbyist game development, and it includes all the core features.
Limitations:
The free version is obfuscated (for code protection) and
does not allow modification or commercial use
. You are free to use it in non-commercial games, but modification of the plugin is restricted to protect the source.
Fully Functional:
You can use the plugin as-is to add and manage quests in your game without any missing features.
Paid Version:
The paid version offers an extended license that allows
modification and commercial use
. This version is intended for users who wish to sell their games or need to make custom changes to the plugin for their project. The paid version is affordably priced to support the developer and help improve future plugins.
Benefits of the Paid Version:
Grants permission to modify the plugin to suit your specific needs.
Allows you to use the plugin in commercial projects.
Supports the ongoing development of more plugins and features.
Price:
The paid version is kept low-cost (1 USD) as a token of support. If you’re using the plugin in a commercial project or need customization, consider supporting the developer by purchasing the full version.
Planned Features:
Integration with PKD Simple Quest System
Support and License:
The plugin is licensed to allow use in personal and non-commercial projects for free. If you wish to modify or use the plugin commercially, a purchase is required to support the developer. Credit to the developer is required for all projects.
For any problems or suggestions, feel free to contact me directly.
Hey guys! I am actively working on making this better and adding more functionality. I haven't tested the limited version; If you include
any
bugs or crashes, let me know and ill fix it as soon as I can.
If you would like to help me, or use my product commercially feel free to purchase the full version for $1 USD, this is considered very cheap and is to help me produce more plugins. If you have any requests for plugins to be made, please let me know!
Thank you for supporting indie development!
LIFE SIM ADVERT
Escape the Ordinary in This Life Simulator!
You've just left home and landed in a cramped apartment, alone and struggling to make ends meet. In this life simulator, you must navigate the challenges of independence, find work, and decide if you'll stick to the straight and narrow—or plunge into a life of crime. The choice is yours!
Game Features:​
Wanted System
Get ready for high-stakes decisions. If you're spotted committing a crime, you'll be wanted by the authorities. Will you evade capture or face the consequences?
Daily Jobs
Experience life in a variety of roles: work as a librarian, serve as a cop, or take the path of a criminal. Each job brings new opportunities and risks.
Wardrobe System
Customize your look! Visit the mall to buy clothing and dress up for any occasion, whether it’s for work, a night out, or just to stand out.
Go Clubbing
Meet up with friends, let loose, and live it up! Explore the nightlife and see where it takes you.
Go to School
Need a boost to your intellect? Enroll in community college! Just be prepared for the cost—education isn't cheap.
Random Events
Life’s full of surprises. From chance encounters to unexpected situations, every day brings something new.
Join Us in Development!​
Progress:
20% Complete
Price:
Free (with Patreon support)
Start your journey toward independence and make every choice count!
